free_tier.stated: Cloudflare for Startups gives early-stage companies up to $350k in credits to build the next big idea ... Get started with $10k in credits to build and launch your product, no minimum funding required.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a tunnel or an address, not an object

retention.stated: not applicable: a live tunnel, not stored bytes

egress.terms: the $10k tier carries no byte allowance of its own because Cloudflare's developer platform has no metered egress to spend it on; ingress: http-only

tooling: wrangler and the Cloudflare API; no VM is involved
chaining: composes with a free VM elsewhere rather than replacing it: the credit buys Workers and R2, not an ingress port

limits.value: a company application, with the tier set by amount raised

binding_note: two things fail before volume: the applicant must be a company, and the credit spends only on Cloudflare products, which already carry no egress meter. There is nothing for 1 TiB a month to run out of.

identity_cost.detail: a for-profit business with a business email matching its domain, no personal email addresses; tiers set by funding stage ('Under $1M raised' for the $10k tier, 'Under $5M raised' for the $100k tier)

reliability_note: credits last one year from approval; R2 is covered only up to a cap per tier
confidence_note: the tier structure is first-party and read today; whether a sole founder with no entity can apply is not stated

evidence.proved: 'up to $350k in credits', 'Get started with $10k in credits ... no minimum funding required', 'Under $1M raised', 'Credits: $10k', 'Under $5M raised', 'Credits: $100k'
applicants need a business email matching their domain
evidence.quote: Business email required — no personal email addresses
Receive up to $350,000 in credits for a year to support your startup.

evidence.proved: R2 credit cover is capped at $2,500 (Tier 3), $5,000 (Tier 2), $10,000 (Tier 1)
evidence.quote: R2 Object Storage:** Covered up to a $2,500 cap for Tier 3, $5,000 for Tier 2, and $10,000 for Tier 1.

evidence.proved: the programme is for companies, not individuals
evidence.quote: For-profit business with a business email matching your domain

notes: Startup program providing Cloudflare credits up to USD 100,000 for funded companies. Standard free tiers on Workers and R2 already include zero-egress data transfer.

extras.wg_detail: Cloudflare sells no VM; the credits spend on Workers, R2 and the rest of the developer platform, none of which hands an account a UDP port on a public IPv4
extras.volume_stated: the $10k tier carries no byte allowance of its own because Cloudflare's developer platform has no metered egress to spend it on
extras.transit_note: Cloudflare carries the bytes on its own network, which is the part that is already free
